# Remparia

> Remparia helps specialized professions deploy supervised business agents: measurable time returned, human decisions preserved, data under control.

Remparia is a French operator partner for regulated and trust-based professions (legal, finance, health, notarial, consulting). We use the SIGNAL protocol — six stages from fieldwork to production — to integrate agents into existing tools without black-box dependency.

## Agent-readable site view

Append `?view=agent` to any public page URL to switch from the human UI to a Markdown source view optimized for LLMs and agent crawlers (toggle HUMAN | AGENT on the page).

Example: https://www.remparia.com/fr?view=agent

## What we do not do

- We do not replace professional judgment or accountability.
- We do not deploy unmanaged automation on sensitive data.
- We do not sell generic tools without field integration and governance.
